stories.title: Vance heads back to U.S. after positive start to U.S.-Iran talks
stories.summary: Vice President Vance is on his way back to the U.S. after he said negotiators made progress toward a lasting peace deal.

stories.title: With Starmer's resignation, the U.K. is set for its 7th PM in 10 years
stories.summary: Andy Burnham, a newly elected member of Parliament, plans to run for prime minister, replacing Keir Starmer, who resigned Monday.

stories.title: Music lovers in Paris turned out in droves for the Fête de la Musique despite hot temps
stories.summary: Almost 50 years on, an American's idea for a citywide outdoor celebration of music in Paris has grown into Fête de la Musique, where the city's streets become a global music block party.

stories.title: A look at the science that's been lost on long COVID
stories.summary: Since President Trump took office, hundreds of experts advising on science and research issues have been dismissed. One committee was on long COVID, an issue that doctors are desperate for help with.

stories.title: 50 years on, an EPA time capsule at the Kennedy Space Center remains a mystery
stories.summary: For the Bicentennial in 1976, the Environmental Protection Agency buried a time capsule with the promise to open it this year. It's a promise the agency may not fulfill.

stories.title: Trouble getting weight loss drugs covered by insurance? Here's what to know
stories.summary: What to do if your insurance denies your obesity drug.
